input_messages.content: Hi! I recently realized there might be a mixup with my flight bookings. Could you please check my profile to see if there are multiple flights booked for the same day? My name is Sophia Martin.
Sure, my user ID is sophia_martin_4574. Could you please check if there are any overlapping flights in my bookings?

Thanks for the detailed information. I will be arriving in New York from Dallas on May 17 and leaving Boston on May 22. Could you please help me figure out which flights should be canceled to avoid conflicts? I want to keep my other reservations as they are.
The reason for cancellation is a change of plan. Yes, please go ahead and cancel FDZ0T5 and HSR97W. Leave all my other reservations as they are. Thank you!

No, that's all for now. Thanks for your help in sorting this out! Have a great day. 

###STOP###

description.purpose: Check agent's capacity to look up reservation info, find duplicates, reason about locations, passengers, times and cancel the correct flights. User will be in arriving in New York from Dallas on May 17 and will be leaving Boston on May 22. Agent should reason about the locations, passengers, times and cancel the correct flights. The flight from LAX on May 17 is not relevant because the user is not a passenger. The flight from JFK on May 17 leaves before the flight from EWR arrives so should be cancelled. User will be leaving Boston on May 22 so cannot fly out of ORD. The flight from ORD should be cancelled.
